label: Glad / Sad / Mad + appreciations
description: The classic feelings retro, with appreciations for the people who helped and a separate place for ideas.

types.label: Glad
types.description: Something that made you happy or proud.

types.label: Appreciation
types.description: Thank someone for something specific they did.

types.label: Sad
types.description: Something disappointing, or that could have gone better.

types.label: Mad
types.description: Something frustrating that got in the way.

types.label: Idea
types.description: Something we could try to make next sprint better.

questions: Is there a pattern in what made us mad?
Who deserves a thank-you that they have not had yet?
aiGuidance: Keep appreciations as they are (with the names) and list them first. For sad and mad items, focus on situations and systems, never on blaming people. Suggest action items mainly from the ideas, linked to the sad or mad items they address.
